description: This file defines the Order class within the OpenCart system, responsible for handling email notifications related to order status changes, including order addition, history updates, and alerts. It interacts with models for retrieving order data, store info, language, and performs email task scheduling.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class responsible for composing and scheduling email notifications when order statuses change, including order creation, updates, and alerts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the trigger to send order information email upon order status change, calling add or history methods as needed.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Prepares and schedules an email task for a new order, including gathering order details, products, links, addresses, and totals.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Prepares and schedules an email task for order status updates, including order details and comments.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Prepares and schedules an alert email to administrators or specified recipients about a new order, including order details and products.
